title: Reusable Eco Laundry Ball – Up to 1,000 Washes
description_html:
Reusable Eco Laundry Ball for Everyday Loads

Laundry often means another bottle, another measure and another product to replace. This refillable Eco Laundry Ball uses natural minerals for a 4 kg wash without added detergent, fragrance or fabric softener, giving you a simpler option for regular loads.

Key Features

  • One ball for a 4 kg wash.
  • Reusable for up to 1,000 washes.
  • Natural minerals clean without added detergent, fragrance or fabric softener.
  • Recharge in sunlight for a few hours each month with regular use.
  • Recyclable outer ball where suitable facilities accept it.
  • Refillable design for repeat use.

Make wash day simpler with a refillable laundry ball that replaces repeat detergent-bottle purchases in your regular routine.
